answer: By the ridge of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, split across independent auditors, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. A cedar of per-task receipts records who did what, and the ivory of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
